subject: Post-demo: Redwood inference — vendor onboarding & procurement next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@aurorapay.com>, Priya Desai <priya.desai@aurorapay.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: Redwood inference — vendor onboarding & procurement next steps

Hi Priya / Liam — thanks again for your time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side: 

- Recap: demo covered hosted API, Dedicated reserved capacity options, and our vendor onboarding requirements for private deployments (KMS integrations, SOC2 attestations).
- Next actions we need from Aurora: 1) procurement contact + preferred vendor form, 2) who the economic buyer is for infra/platform spend, 3) PO terms (net-30 / net-45) and invoicing details, 4) any mandatory security paperwork (SOC2, DPA) or legal redlines up front.

Attached: redwood_sow_draft_v1.pdf (SOW draft) and redwood_w9.pdf. Happy to convert the SOW to DocuSign if that's easier. 

Proposed timing: if procurement can review the SOW + vendor form this week, we can have a signed SOW / PO finalized within ~2 weeks and onboard in 3-4 weeks, depending on procurement lead time. Please confirm the procurement contact and timeline.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0132
www.redwood.ai

Attachments: redwood_sow_draft_v1.pdf, redwood_w9.pdf

From: Priya Desai <priya.desai@aurorapay.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@aurorapay.com, Raj Patel <raj.patel@aurorapay.com>
Date: Sat, 13 Mar 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Redwood inference — vendor onboarding & procurement next steps

Hi Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. A few notes from procurement: 

- Procurement lead: Raj Patel (cc'd) will own vendor onboarding. You can loop procurement@aurorapay.com for status.
- Economic buyer: Liam O'Connor (Head of Engineering) is the approver for platform spend > $50k.
- Vendor paperwork: please fill and return our vendor form (attached) and provide an executed W9 and SOC2 Type II or link to attestation.
- PO terms: Aurora prefers Net-30. Standard onboarding target is 3-6 weeks after receipt of completed vendor form + signed SOW + W9; if legal needs to review redlines that can add 1-2 weeks.

I've attached aurora_vendor_form_filled.pdf with our internal tracking fields. For the SOW: if you can send a signed SOW and a W9 we can push a PO. If you prefer, we can accept a DocuSign purchase order instead — whichever is faster for your side.

Let me know if you need a template for invoice remittance or payment contact.

Best,
Priya Desai
Director, Partnerships | Aurora Payments
priya.desai@aurorapay.com

Attachment: aurora_vendor_form_filled.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Desai <priya.desai@aurorapay.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@aurorapay.com>, procurement@aurorapay.com
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 14 Mar 2027 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Redwood inference — vendor onboarding & procurement next steps

Thanks Priya / Raj — appreciate the quick turnaround and the clarity on net-30 and the economic buyer. Per your ask: 

- Attached: redwood_sow_signed_v1.pdf (signed by Redwood) and redwood_w9.pdf (attached previously but re-attaching).
- SOC2: we host our attestations and evidence; link to SOC2 and penetration test summary is here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cRedwoodDocs (let me know if you need exports).
- Invoicing / remittance: we can invoice on receipt of PO (net-30). Our billing contact is billing@redwood.ai and can accept email invoices or a DocuSign PO.

I created a quick HubSpot deal note for visibility: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/8901 (deal RDW-2027-AUR-23). If procurement wants a DocuSign PO, I've generated one here: https://www.docusign.com/en/detail/ABCDEF123456 — happy to complete that route if it's faster.

Next steps from Redwood: confirm the invoice remittance details you want included, and we'll wait for the PO/DocuSign. Happy to jump on a 15-min call with Raj and Liam to speed sign-off.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0132

Attachments: redwood_sow_signed_v1.pdf, redwood_w9.pdf

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Redwood inference — quick pricing/discount confirmation

Marissa / Neha — quick internal check before we finalize: Priya indicated Liam is the economic buyer. Are we able to honor the promotional onboarding credits we discussed (first 2 months 20% off Dedicated) or do we need to route for approval? I want to confirm final numbers so Marissa can share a clean SOW + invoice.

—Dylan

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Redwood inference — quick pricing/discount confirmation

Dylan — Neha confirmed in our last internal that we can apply the promotional onboarding credit for new Dedicated customers up to $25k on first invoice. I'm going to note that in the SOW and include an invoice line item so procurement/Liam sees the credit. I'll re-upload the SOW to HubSpot and ping Raj to confirm.

Marissa
